ALLERGY.description: A flower, scent or plant they react to or must never be sent, for their own sake or a recipient's. Honored, never weighed.

DELIVERY.description: How a delivery to them should go: a door code, a time window, a neighbour to leave it with.

BUDGET.description: What they usually spend, or how often they order, in their own words.

OCCASION.description: A date they buy for every year: an anniversary, a birthday, a memorial.

FAVORITE.description: Flowers, colours or styles they love to get or to send.

DISLIKE.description: What they would rather not get, short of an allergy.

RECIPIENT.description: Someone they send flowers to, and how they relate.

NOTE.description: Anything else worth keeping that fits no other type.

briefHeader: Before you take an order from {who}:
charter:
# What the shop keeps

Keep what would change the next order: what they love, what must never be sent, the dates they buy for and who they send to. Leave out small talk.
